text: Miriam's son Jonah graduates from Leeds on July 9th. Remind me to send her a card the day before so it actually arrives in time.
Kaito is vegan now, fully, not just at home. Also allergic to sesame, which rules out half the places I'd normally suggest.

Svetlana's daughter starts reception on 3 September 2026. She sounded more nervous about it than the little one is. They've done two settling-in mornings already and apparently it went well, but Svetlana still hasn't decided whether to go back to work full time or stay at three days. Her husband thinks she should wait until after Christmas.
Bogdan only drinks oat flat whites. Writing it down because I got it wrong again this morning.

Lunch with Amara and her husband Rhys. They're celebrating ten years married on June 3rd and are thinking about Lisbon for it. She mentioned she's off dairy for the moment because of some stomach trouble, and Rhys has gone completely teetotal since January. Should book somewhere with decent alcohol-free options if we do dinner before they go.
Need to pick up the dry cleaning before Thursday.
Rafael's mock exams start May 14. His mum says he's barely sleeping. Don't forget to text him good luck the night before.
Katarzyna (Kasia) has coeliac disease, properly diagnosed last year. Bring the gluten-free brownies on Saturday, not the regular ones.
Simone mentioned her dad is retiring at the end of March 2027 after thirty-one years at the council. They're planning a surprise do for him.
Chat with Hoang after football. His twins started nursery last week and apparently one of them bit another kid on day two. He's mortified but laughing about it.
Remind me to ask Astrid how her driving test went. It was on 10/14 and I completely forgot to check.
Anders loves peaty whisky, Laphroaig especially. His birthday's 2 November 2026, so that's the gift sorted.
Jaya is doing her nursing graduation on December 12th. Her grandmother is flying over from Kochi for it, first time on a plane in twenty years.
Kieran called. The trip to Galway is off because his sister's wedding got moved to the same weekend. So he's at the wedding instead, 21 August 2027.
Claire's little boy, Ayo, lost his first tooth today. She was more emotional than he was.
Tendai hates coriander with a passion. Also doesn't eat pork. Keep that in mind for the barbecue.
I'm taking Sana to the airport on April 30th, early flight. Her interview in Toronto is the following Monday. Should message her the evening after to see how it went.
Lukas asked me to save him a ticket for the school play. His daughter Alessia is playing the wolf.

Ciara is struggling a lot at the moment. Her mum had a fall in September and Ciara has been driving up to Belfast every weekend since. She said she hasn't had a proper night's sleep in weeks. I should ring her on Sunday evening just to check in, and maybe offer to cover one of the visits.
Omar's SATs results came back. Top marks in maths. Very proud dad.
Must book a vet appointment for the cat before we go away on the 28th.
Dinner at Aurelio's was lovely. He's an incredible cook but can't stand anything spicy, which is funny given his job.
Kavya and her partner Aidan are moving to Bristol in March 2027. She's got a new job lined up at the university there, starting in April.
Layla is expecting! Due early May. She's been very sick so far, can barely keep crackers down. Remind me to send flowers the week after the scan on November 18th.
Matteo only drinks Peroni or water. Don't bring wine.

Rin has her piano grade six exam on 6/21. Help her practise the scales the weekend before if she asks. Her teacher Mrs Hughes thinks she's ready, but Rin keeps freezing on the sight-reading part. Her parents have promised her a trip to the coast if she passes, which seems to be helping.
Amy said her son Jonah got into the grammar school. Results came through yesterday and the whole house was screaming apparently.
Bogdan's partner Miriam is pescatarian, but she'll eat chicken if there's nothing else. He eats everything, including the things she won't.
Note to self: pick up the cake on Friday morning, then the decorations, then remember to charge the camera before Saturday.
Svetlana's brother Lukas is having knee surgery on January 15. She's worried because he's diabetic and the last op took ages to heal.

Kaito Yilmaz from accounts is leaving at the end of the month. Leaving drinks are on the 30th at the Crown. Remind me to sign his card before Wednesday. He's off to work for a start-up in Manchester, mostly remote, and seemed genuinely excited about it. He doesn't drink, so I'll get him a lime and soda rather than the usual round.
Anders and Simone are having a housewarming on 7 November 2026. Simone's allergic to nuts, so nothing with almonds.
Uncle Rafael turns seventy on June 2nd. Big party at the golf club. Aunt Simone hinted that he wants a decent pair of binoculars for the birdwatching.

Long call with Ayo. His exams finish on May 22nd and then he's off travelling around Vietnam for six weeks with his girlfriend Ciara. He said she's a bit nervous about the food, because she's a really fussy eater and doesn't do seafood at all. I should send him that list of restaurants in Hanoi the week before they fly.
Hoang's dog Biscuit is having an operation on his hip next Tuesday. Hoang is pretty anxious about it.
Need to buy a graduation present for Tendai before 5/19. Something to do with photography, he's mad about it.
Dr Fischer said Amara's results should be back by December 3rd. I'm driving her to the follow-up appointment.

Jaya told me she's given up caffeine entirely. Rooibos only now. Also she's training for a half marathon in April 2027. She runs with her brother Kieran on Sunday mornings and he's apparently much faster, which annoys her. She's raising money for the hospice where their grandad was looked after, so I should sponsor her before the end of the year.
Kieran's daughter starts secondary school in September. He keeps saying he's fine with it but clearly isn't.
Rhys's mum passed away on Sunday. The funeral is on October 29th. I must call him tomorrow evening and see how he's holding up.
Lovely afternoon at the park, nothing much to report.
Claire said Katarzyna got the promotion. She starts as head of department after Christmas. I should congratulate her when I see her on Thursday.
Omar's wife Layla can't have lactose, and Omar only drinks black coffee. He's also mad about Arsenal, in case I need small talk.
Astrid's graduation ceremony was on July 16. I never asked how it went. Remind me to message her this week.
Matteo said his son Aurelio has his first football match for the under-nines on Saturday morning. He's been practising penalties in the garden every night.
Kavya mentioned she's been dropping hints about a new Le Creuset pot for her birthday, which is March 14.
Amy and her husband are off to Japan from April 4th to April 20th 2027. She's been learning Japanese for two years and is a bit nervous to actually use it.
Sana's son Kieran is sitting his GCSEs next summer. She wants a tutor for chemistry. I should send her Mrs Moreau's number.
Book train tickets for the 12th, and confirm the hotel for the 13th and 14th.
Rin likes milky tea with two sugars. Bogdan takes his black.
Text from Svetlana: the christening is cancelled because the vicar's ill. They'll do a small lunch at home on the 9th instead.
Jonah's wedding is on 15 May 2027. Remind me the morning of to order the flowers for the table, and the day after to send him a message congratulating them both.
Lukas Andersson keeps an eye on his cholesterol, so no fried food at the work lunch.
Ciara's dad has a hospital appointment on November 6. She asked me to remind her the day before.
Rafael is vegetarian, but eats fish on Fridays because of his gran. Odd but fine.
Talked to Miriam about her daughter's first day at primary school. It went fine, apparently, but she cried at the gate.
Aidan is learning to brew his own beer. Says his first batch will be ready by Christmas and I'm getting a bottle.
Reminder: dentist on November 4th at 9:15, and pay the council tax before the end of the month.

Alessia and Kaito met up with me for coffee. She's starting a PhD in Edinburgh in October 2027, and he's moving up with her in the summer. Kaito wants to open a little ramen place once they're settled, which honestly would be amazing. I need to remember to ask her about funding when she hears back in February.

Tendai's daughter, Jaya, finishes school on June 20th. Big leavers' party that evening. He's dreading the speech he has to give. Jaya has a place at Glasgow to study medicine in September if her grades come through on August 13th. Remind me to text him the morning of the party to say good luck with the speech, and then message Jaya on results day.
